# Assam Wild Safari (Manas Holidays) — full details

Business: Assam Wild Safari, also known as Manas Holidays. Location: Abhayapuri, Assam, India. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93656 09948, +91 97098 84206. Website: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com.
Services: jeep safari booking (Kaziranga, Manas), North East India tour packages, airport / railway station pickup & drop, car rental. Prices are in Indian rupees (INR). Last updated: 2026-11-16.

## Kaziranga National Park jeep safari (https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/kaziranga-jungle-safari/)
- Private jeep, per jeep (Indian / foreigner / max guests): Central Range (Kohora) ₹3,600 / ₹7,000 / 5; Western Range (Bagori) ₹3,700 / ₹7,100 / 5; Eastern Range (Agoratoli) ₹3,600 / ₹7,000 / 5; Burapahar Range ₹3,600 / ₹7,000 / 5
- Shared jeep per person: ₹1,000 (Indian), ₹1,700 (foreigner, includes entry fee); fixed zone: Central Range (Kohora)
- Time slots: private Morning Entry 6:30 – 10:00 AM · safari lasts 3 hours; shared Morning 8:00 – 11:00 AM; shared Afternoon 2:00 – 5:00 PM; private Afternoon Entry 1:30 – 3:00 PM · exit before 5:30 PM
- Booking: request online; availability checked; payment link sent on WhatsApp. ID: Aadhaar for Indian guests; passport or other ID for foreign guests.

## Manas National Park jeep safari (https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/manas-jungle-safari/)
- Private jeep, per jeep (Indian / foreigner / max guests): Bansbari Zone ₹5,500 / ₹9,000 / 5; Bhuyan Para Range ₹6,000 / ₹10,000 / 5; Kahitama Zone ₹6,500 / ₹10,500 / 5; Kokilabari Zone ₹10,500 / ₹13,000 / 5; Bansbari to Panbang (Bhutan) ₹9,200 / Indian only / 5
- Shared jeep per person: ₹1,500 (Indian), ₹2,200 (foreigner, includes entry fee); fixed zone: Bansbari Zone
- Time slots: private Morning Entry 6:30 – 10:00 AM · safari lasts 3 hours; shared Morning 8:00 – 11:00 AM; shared Afternoon 2:00 – 5:00 PM; private Afternoon Entry 1:30 – 3:00 PM · exit before 5:30 PM
- Camera fees per camera: still ₹200 (Indian) / ₹1,000 (foreigner); video ₹10,000 / ₹20,000
- Closed on Tuesdays
- Booking: request online; availability checked; payment link sent on WhatsApp. ID: Aadhaar for Indian guests; passport or other ID for foreign guests.

## North East India itineraries (https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/)
### Manas National Park & Panbang (Bhutan) — 3 Nights / 4 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/manas-national-park-and-panbang-bhutan/
Route: Manas National Park → Panbang (Bhutan) → Manas
Day 1: Receive at Manas National Park. Overnight at Manas.
Day 2: Jeep safari to Panbang. Morning jeep safari through Manas National Park and Royal Manas up to Panbang, Bhutan. Overnight at Panbang (river side room).
Day 3: Twin waterfalls & jungle safari. Visit the twin waterfalls. After lunch, jungle safari back through the national park. Overnight at Manas.
Day 4: Check out. After breakfast, check out.

### Manas, Raimona National Park & Bhutan — 5 Nights / 6 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/manas-raimona-national-park-and-bhutan/
Route: New Bongaigaon → Raimona → Gelephu → Manas → Panbang → New Bongaigaon
Day 1: Arrival at New Bongaigaon → Raimona National Park. Arrival at New Bongaigaon railway station and transfer to Raimona National Park (2 hours). After lunch, jeep safari. Halt.
Day 2: Transfer to Gelephu, Bhutan. After breakfast, transfer to Gelephu, Bhutan (91 km, 2.5 hours). Halt.
Day 3: Gelephu sightseeing → Manas. Gelephu local sightseeing. After lunch, transfer to Manas. Halt.
Day 4: Jeep safari to Panbang, Bhutan. Morning jeep safari to Panbang, Bhutan, inside Manas National Park and Royal Manas, Bhutan. Halt at Bhutan river side accommodation.
Day 5: Twin waterfalls & hanging bridge. Morning visit to the twin waterfalls and hanging bridge. After lunch, back to Manas National Park and jeep safari inside the national park. Halt at Manas.
Day 6: Elephant ride (optional) & Kakoijana. Morning elephant ride (optional). After breakfast, Kakoijana forest (sure sighting of the endangered golden langur). After lunch, drop at New Bongaigaon railway station (15 km) for the Saraighat or Vande Bharat Express. Tour end.

### Guwahati, Shillong, Dawki, Mawlynnong & Cherrapunji — 4 Nights / 5 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/guwahati-shillong-dawki-mawlynnong-and-cherrapunji/
Route: Guwahati → Shillong → Dawki → Mawlynnong → Cherrapunji → Guwahati
Day 1: Pickup from Guwahati → Shillong. Pickup from Guwahati airport or railway station. Transfer to Shillong. Overnight at Shillong.
Day 2: Shillong local sightseeing. Shillong local sightseeing. Stay at Shillong.
Day 3: Shillong → Dawki → Mawlynnong → Cherrapunji. Shillong to Dawki and Mawlynnong village, then transfer to Cherrapunji. Stay at Cherrapunji.
Day 4: Cherrapunji local sightseeing. Cherrapunji local sightseeing. Stay at Cherrapunji.
Day 5: Cherrapunji → Guwahati. Cherrapunji to Guwahati. Evening river cruise. Stay at Guwahati.
Day 6: Maa Kamakhya darshan & drop. Maa Kamakhya darshan and drop at Guwahati airport or railway station. Tour end.

### Guwahati, Kaziranga & Tawang (Arunachal Pradesh) — 6 Nights / 7 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/guwahati-kaziranga-and-tawang-arunachal-pradesh/
Route: Guwahati → Bomdila/Shergaon → Tawang → Dirang → Bhalukpong → Guwahati
Day 1: Guwahati → Bomdila / Shergaon. Guwahati to Bomdila or Shergaon via Kalaktang. Stay at Shergaon or Bomdila. 300 km (8 hours).
Day 2: Bomdila → Tawang via Sela Pass. Bomdila to Tawang, 180 km (6 hours), via Sela Pass. Stay at Tawang.
Day 3: Bumla Pass & Sungester Lake. Visit Bumla Pass and Sungester Lake. Evening back to Tawang. Stay at Tawang.
Day 4: Tawang → Dirang (Sangti Valley). Tawang to Dirang (Sangti Valley), 140 km (5 hours). Stay at Dirang.
Day 5: Dirang → Bhalukpong. Dirang to Bhalukpong, 150 km (4 hours). Stay at Bhalukpong.
Day 6: Bhalukpong → Guwahati. Bhalukpong to Guwahati, 270 km (5 hours). Stay at Guwahati.
Day 7: Maa Kamakhya darshan & drop. Morning Maa Kamakhya darshan and drop at Guwahati airport or railway station. Tour end.

### Guwahati, Shillong, Dawki, Cherrapunji & Kaziranga — 6 Nights / 7 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/guwahati-shillong-dawki-cherrapunji-and-kaziranga/
Route: Guwahati → Shillong → Dawki → Cherrapunji → Kaziranga → Guwahati
Day 1: Pickup from Guwahati → Shillong. Pickup from Guwahati airport or railway station. Transfer to Shillong. Overnight at Shillong.
Day 2: Shillong local sightseeing. Shillong local sightseeing. Stay at Shillong.
Day 3: Shillong → Dawki → Mawlynnong → Cherrapunji. Shillong to Dawki and Mawlynnong village, then transfer to Cherrapunji. Stay at Cherrapunji.
Day 4: Cherrapunji local sightseeing. Cherrapunji local sightseeing. Stay at Cherrapunji.
Day 5: Cherrapunji → Kaziranga. Cherrapunji to Kaziranga. Stay at Kaziranga.

Day 7: Maa Kamakhya darshan & drop. Morning Maa Kamakhya darshan and drop at Guwahati airport or railway station. Tour end.

### Manas National Park & Arunachal Pradesh (Tawang Sector) — 7 Nights / 8 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/manas-national-park-and-arunachal-pradesh-tawang-sector/
Route: New Bongaigaon → Manas → Bomdila → Tawang → Dirang → Guwahati
Day 1: Arrival at Manas. Pickup from New Bongaigaon station (90 km / 2 hrs). On the way visit Kokoijana forest (sure sighting of the endangered golden langur). Overnight in Manas.
Day 2: Manas safaris. Elephant ride (optional) at 6 AM. After lunch: jeep safari. Overnight in Manas.
Day 3: Manas → Bomdila. 320 km / 8 hrs. Overnight at Bomdila.
Day 4: Bomdila → Tawang via Sela Pass. Via Sela Pass (13,700 ft), 180 km / 6 hrs. Overnight at Tawang.
Day 5: Bumla Pass & Madhuri Lake. Bumla Pass (15,200 ft) and Madhuri Lake. Evening return to Tawang.
Day 6: Tawang → Dirang. Tawang Monastery, Buddha Statue, Nuranang Falls and Sangti Valley. 140 km / 5 hrs.
Day 7: Dirang → Guwahati. Transfer and overnight at Guwahati.
Day 8: Kamakhya Temple darshan & drop. Kamakhya Temple darshan. Drop at Guwahati airport or railway station. Tour end.

### Arunachal Anini Tour Package — 5 Nights / 6 Days
URL: https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/arunachal-anini-tour-package/
Route: Dibrugarh Airport → Roing → Anini → Roing → Dibrugarh Airport
Day 1: Dibrugarh Airport pickup → Roing. Upon arrival at Dibrugarh Airport, meet our driver and proceed towards Roing, Arunachal Pradesh, via Tinsukia and Dhola–Sadiya Bridge, depending on the selected route and road conditions. Enjoy the scenic journey with suitable breaks for lunch, refreshments and relaxation. On arrival in Roing, check in to the hotel, enjoy dinner and overnight stay. Night stay: Roing. Approximate distance: 150–180 km.
Day 2: Roing → Mayodia Pass → Hunli → Anini. After an early breakfast, proceed towards Anini through the beautiful mountain roads of Mayodia Pass and Hunli. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views, lush green forests, misty landscapes and photo stops at safe locations, subject to weather and road conditions. Arrive in Anini, check in to the hotel, enjoy dinner and relax after the long mountain drive. Night stay: Anini. Approximate distance: 200–235 km. Travel note: approximately 7–9 hours or longer, depending on road conditions.
Day 3: Anini local sightseeing. After breakfast, explore Anini town and its surrounding natural beauty: Anini town exploration, scenic mountain viewpoints, beautiful valleys and nature photography, nearby local villages or cultural spots (subject to accessibility and permission) and leisure time to enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Return to the hotel in the afternoon and enjoy a relaxed evening. Night stay: Anini.
Day 4: Anini – Dibang Valley nature excursion. After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed day exploring the scenic surroundings of Anini and Dibang Valley: visit accessible valley viewpoints, enjoy panoramic mountain views, explore nearby riverbanks or village areas (subject to road access) and nature photography. Return to the hotel for lunch and relaxation. The sightseeing schedule remains flexible depending on weather, road conditions and local accessibility. Night stay: Anini.
Day 5: Anini → Hunli → Mayodia Pass → Roing. After breakfast, check out and begin the return journey towards Roing via Hunli and Mayodia Pass. Enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery along the way, with suitable breaks for refreshments and rest. Upon arrival in Roing, check in to the hotel and relax. Dinner and overnight stay. Night stay: Roing. Travel note: allow approximately 7–9 hours or longer, depending on road and weather conditions.
Day 6: Roing → Dibrugarh Airport drop. After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Dibrugarh Airport. Enjoy the return drive with suitable refreshment breaks. Arrive at the airport for your onward journey according to your flight schedule. Tour ends with beautiful memories of Arunachal Pradesh.
